'''Madison''' (Japanese: '''エル''' ''Elle'') and '''Alexa''' (Japanese: '''リサ''' ''Lisa'') are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP205|The Kecleon Caper]]''. 

They are a pair of rich young sisters who are traveling the world in the massive "Leviathan Two", a luxury [[Air transportation in the Pokémon world#Blimps|blimp]]. They dress in fur coats and each have a {{p|Kecleon}}. {{an|Brock}} helped their Kecleon recover from motion sickness.

|desc=Madison and Alexa each own a {{p|Kecleon}}, Madison's being '''Reddy''' (Japanese: '''アズキちゃん''' ''Azuki-chan'') and Alexa's being '''Greeny''' (Japanese: '''ミドリちゃん''' ''Midori-chan''), respectively. The two Kecleon like to steal things to cause people to play hide and seek with them. The Kecleon had motion sickness when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} saw them. Shortly afterward, {{an|Brock}} gave them some medicine and home-made [[Pokémon food]], and they became well again.

When playing in their room, Greeny spotted {{MTR}} with Alexa's jewelry box, and it quickly used its tongue to snatch it from him. Later the Kecleon went missing and the group tried to find them; {{TRT}} were pursuing the Kecleon, which were running all around the blimp. The Kecleon were able to escape on several occasions, and in the end, Team Rocket were sent blasting off. Madison and Alexa were happily reunited with their troublesome Pokémon, and returned a stolen gentleman's first aid kit, which the Kecleon had also stolen.

Reddy and Greeny's known moves are {{m|Lick}} and {{m|Psybeam}}, and their Ability is {{a|Color Change}}.}}

==Trivia==
* Reddy's Japanese name comes from the {{wp|azuki bean}}, which are used to make [[Old Gateau|yōkan]], referring to its red color. Greeny's Japanese name is merely the Japanese word for ''green''.
* Their Kecleon marked the first {{pkmn|animated series}} appearance of a Pokémon from [[Generation III]].
